function.arguments: {"thought":"Testing exposed a subtle live-collaboration conflict issue: liveRevision advances the browser base to the newest revision while preserving a same-cell dirty draft. If the user then edits that conflict cell to 'resolve' it and saves, the server sees the advanced base and would permit overwrite. The UI currently blocks while conflict is marked, but editing clears the mark. A safe resolution needs either discarding local draft or explicitly rebasing based on remote value. Simplest safe behavior: remote same-cell collisions stay blocked; provide a visible action to accept the remote value. However the live event currently doesn't store remote values. Add a conflictValues map and panel/message action would be more UI work. Alternatively keep conflict marker even on edits, but no resolution path. Better: on conflict show panel with 'Keep draft is blocked; reload to accept saved value'. Yet user can reload. Requirement only says preserve draft and show visible conflict, not necessarily in-place resolve. Prevent apply from clearing existing conflict ensures no overwrite; reload resolves safely."}
function.name: think
